title: Your Privacy Choices
body:
As described in our Privacy Policy, we collect personal information from your interactions with us and our website, including through cookies and similar technologies. We may also share this personal information with third parties, including advertising partners. We do this in order to show you ads on other websites that are more relevant to your interests and for other reasons outlined in our privacy policy.

Sharing of personal information for targeted advertising based on your interaction on different websites may be considered "sales", "sharing", or "targeted advertising" under certain U.S. state privacy laws. Depending on where you live, you may have the right to opt out of these activities. If you would like to exercise this opt-out right, please follow the instructions below.

If you visit our website with the Global Privacy Control opt-out preference signal enabled, depending on where you are, we will treat this as a request to opt-out of activity that may be considered a “sale” or “sharing” of personal information or other uses that may be considered targeted advertising for the device and browser you used to visit our website.

title: Weddings & Events
body:
Made live at your event. Picked up by guests. Taken home that night.

The celebration ends. The memories continue.

Enjoy live magnets with your guests, then turn 12 of your favorite wedding photos into a personal collection after the wedding. Included in every guest-count package.

Take it home that night

Guests collect their finished photo magnets during your booked service hours. Your live event magnets are included in your package.

Your private gallery is included

After the celebration, revisit the event photos in your private gallery and take your time choosing favorites. No additional purchase is required to view your gallery.

Your after-wedding 12-pack is included

After your photographer delivers your wedding photos, upload 12 photos of your choice. We turn them into 12 finished 2.5-inch square magnets and ship the set to you, with one standard shipment included.

Your live event magnets, private gallery access and after-wedding 12-pack are included. Want more? The optional 25-extra-magnet add-on is in addition to your included 12, giving you 37 total. Frames and other keepsakes are optional paid purchases.

We print and press photo magnets at your venue. Guests collect their finished magnets during your booked service hours.

A live keepsake experience for weddings & events

Throughout your wedding or event, selected photos are prepared, printed, and finished as premium photo magnets on-site. The result is part guest experience, part favor, and part memory your friends and family will actually keep.

More than magnets

An Atelier Elunora collection is a fully managed event experience—not a magnet-only order. Your collection brings together the creative, operational, and presentation details needed to make the experience feel seamless and intentional.

  • Custom magnet artwork created for your celebration
  • A simple QR photo-sharing experience for guests
  • Coordinated timing, setup, and visual details before the event
  • Live photo preparation and magnet production on-site
  • A dedicated attendant supporting the experience and your guests
  • Refined signage and keepsake presentation
  • A digital gallery preserving the event images afterward

A basic printing price covers the finished item. Your Atelier Elunora collection covers the thoughtful planning and hands-on service that allow those keepsakes to be created and presented beautifully throughout your celebration.

How it works

  1. We prepare for your wedding or event. We coordinate the experience, timing, setup, and visual details in advance.
  2. Your celebration unfolds. Photos captured during the event become the source for personalized keepsakes.
  3. Magnets are created live. Images are prepared and produced during the event.
  4. Guests take the memory home. Finished magnets become a personal keepsake tied to a real moment from your celebration.

Designed to feel part of your celebration

Our approach is intentionally refined and presentation-focused. Atelier Elunora is designed to complement elegant weddings and events rather than feel like a separate novelty station.

For availability, transparent collection pricing, and custom details, explore our Weddings & Events offerings.

Explore Collections & Pricing

Included in every guest-count tier

  • Four hours of live, on-site service
  • Unlimited 2.5-inch square photo magnets during booked service hours
  • Photo station with neutral backdrop, lighting, guest-operated capture and optional props
  • Guest QR photo uploads
  • Custom magnet artwork and coordinated station signage
  • One Atelier Elunora attendant
  • Private event gallery access included; extra magnets beyond the included after-wedding 12-pack are optional paid purchases
  • After-wedding 12-pack for the couple: upload 12 wedding photos of your choice after receiving your photographer’s gallery. We make and ship your finished magnets, with one standard shipment included.
  • Pre-event coordination, setup and breakdown

Photo station experience

Every guest-count tier includes a neutral backdrop, flattering lighting, guest-operated photo capture and optional props. Guests can take a new photo or share their own images by QR code. One attendant supports live magnet production, with photo-station assistance as available; a dedicated photographer is not included.

What does unlimited mean?

No fixed total during your four booked service hours. Each guest may receive one magnet per turn and return for more. Magnets are made in turn at the station; production and pickup end with your booked service time. Your package also includes a separate after-wedding 12-pack for the couple. Further after-event orders and bulk duplicate requests are priced separately.

For 201–250 guests, contact us before paying your retainer so we can confirm production capacity, setup and any staffing requirements. Events for 251–300 guests are booked by custom quote only; contact us to confirm your price and staffing before payment. See current event tier prices. Events above 300 guests require a custom quote.

Service area & travel

title: About Atelier Elunora
body:
Atelier Elunora was created around a simple idea: the best event favors should feel personal enough to keep.

Instead of sending guests home with something disconnected from the celebration, we turn photographs from the event into polished, physical keepsakes. Each magnet carries a moment that actually happened that day.

Why Atelier Elunora

We are building the brand around thoughtful presentation, dependable event execution, and a refined visual experience that belongs naturally in weddings and elevated celebrations.

The name reflects that approach: an atelier is a place where things are thoughtfully made. For us, that means taking a fleeting photograph and turning it into a small piece of the celebration guests can bring home.

title: Frequently Asked Questions
body:
What is included after the wedding, and what costs extra?

Every guest-count package includes private event gallery access and a 12-pack of magnets for the couple. After your photographer delivers your wedding photos, upload 12 photos of your choice. We turn them into 12 finished 2.5-inch square magnets and ship the set to you, with one standard shipment included. Additional magnets beyond those 12, frames and other keepsakes are optional paid purchases. The 25-extra-magnet add-on gives you 37 magnets total.

Do we need to choose all our favorites during the reception?

No. Enjoy the live magnet experience at your event. Once your photographer delivers your wedding photos, choose and upload 12 favorites for your included after-wedding magnet pack. Contact Atelier Elunora with your booking details for photo-upload instructions. Extra magnets beyond the included 12 are optional paid purchases.

Do guests receive their magnets at the event?

Yes. We print and press photo magnets live at your venue. Guests pick up finished magnets during your booked service hours and take them home that night. Every guest-count package also includes a 12-pack made from the couple’s chosen wedding photos and shipped after the wedding. Additional magnets beyond those 12 and other keepsakes are optional paid purchases.

What size are the magnets?

Our signature format is 2.5” × 2.5”.

Do you work only with weddings?

Weddings are a primary focus, but the experience can also be suited to other celebrations and events.

How do I know whether my date is available?

Choose your collection and open the booking calendar to check your event date.

Can I customize the event experience?

Yes. Event length, expected guest count, presentation, and add-ons can be considered when building your event proposal.

How is my date reserved?

Your date is considered reserved after the required booking agreement and payment or deposit are completed.

Can I order magnets without booking an event?

Yes. Order personalized photo magnets directly from our shop, with no event booking required.

How will I upload photos for an online magnet order?

Choose a pack on the photo magnet product page, upload your photographs, and review the square crops before checkout.

Can I return custom magnets or a keepsake frame?

Custom photo magnets and personalized frames are final sale for change-of-mind returns. Non-personalized frames may be returned if requested within 14 days of delivery, unused, undamaged, and securely packaged. You pay change-of-mind return shipping; original shipping is not refundable except where required by law. No restocking fee applies. For frame-and-magnet sets, only a non-personalized frame is eligible; the product page explains its refundable portion and discount allocation.

What if my order arrives damaged or incorrect?

Email support@atelierelunora.com with your order number, a description, and photos where possible. We will arrange an appropriate replacement or refund and cover any required return shipping for a confirmed defect or our error. Custom items are included in this protection, and applicable consumer rights are unaffected.

Can I cancel a custom product order?

You may cancel for a full refund before design or production work begins. Email support@atelierelunora.com as soon as possible. Live wedding and event bookings follow the terms provided in your event agreement.

title: Personalize Your Wedding Keepsake
body:
This page is for your separately ordered wedding keepsake frame, personalized after the wedding. Guest magnets included in your live event collection are made and picked up at the event.

After your wedding, use the order-specific photo-selection or upload link provided by Atelier Elunora. If you have not received it, contact us with your order number.

How many photos should I choose?

The number of magnets depends on the frame size in your order. Your order-specific personalization instructions confirm the exact count. Choose one photo selection per included magnet.

Frame size (inches) Included magnets
12 × 16 12
16 × 20 20
18 × 24 30
24 × 30 48

Before you begin

Have your order number ready. Use high-resolution JPG, JPEG, or PNG photographs with room for cropping to your selected magnet format.

Choose the photo option from your order

Wedding Night Photos

  1. Open the private event gallery provided by Atelier Elunora.
  2. Choose the required number of photo selections for your frame size.
  3. Submit your image numbers or choices using the gallery instructions.

No photo upload is needed for this option.

Your Wedding Photos

  1. Wait until your photographer delivers your photographs.
  2. Open the order-specific upload link provided by Atelier Elunora.
  3. Submit the required number of photo selections and review your crops.

A Mix of Both

Choose photographs from your event gallery and your own photographs in any combination totaling the magnet count included with your frame size. Follow your order-specific instructions to submit both portions.

Your framed image

The main framed display image is selected separately from your magnet photographs. Follow your personalization instructions to submit or confirm it.

When to complete your keepsake

You may personalize your keepsake within six months of your wedding date. Production begins after the required payment, complete photo selections, personalization details and any agreed approval are received. See our Shipping Policy for dispatch timing.

Photo permissions

By submitting photographs, you confirm that you own them or have permission to reproduce them and have the necessary consent for recognizable individuals, including minors where applicable.

Need help or your personalization link? Email support@atelierelunora.com with your order number.
